Date of service: 10/10/2025 | Dr. Felix Merriweather, MD (Rheumatology)

History:
44-year-old woman with rheumatoid arthritis diagnosed in 2021, seen to discuss escalation of therapy. Past medical history: gastroesophageal reflux, type 2 diabetes.

Exam:
Synovitis of the MCP and PIP joints of both hands; no rheumatoid nodules.

Treatment history:
Inadequate response to methotrexate 20 mg weekly for 21 weeks despite good adherence.

Assessment and plan:
Assessment: seropositive rheumatoid arthritis with high disease activity, CDAI 30.
Plan: start fictimab 40 mg subcutaneously every 7 days.
